display.purpose: h1, hero, closing field and menu headlines; Bricolage Grotesque 600, -0.04em to -0.045em. Secondary words in hero and CTA titles dim to the muted colour.

body.purpose: DM Sans running text at 82% of the text colour; leads are muted, 52ch or less.

label.purpose: Small uppercase section label; carried by the build, not a rule for new surfaces.

shadows.name: spotlight

shadows.purpose: Neutral pointer spotlight on .sk-glow cards (white on ink, ink on paper); presence --sl-p fades within 80px, --sl-flare on press; hidden on touch.

shadows.name: glare-band
shadows.value: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1) 30%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.42) 50%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1) 70%, transparent), rotate(25deg), mix-blend-mode screen
shadows.purpose: Sweep across photo cards on hover.

shadows.name: card-scrim

shadows.name: header-glass

gradients.name: brand-soft

components.css: .ds-field { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 28px; padding: 96px 56px; border-radius: 40px; color: #fff; background: radial-gradient(70% 90% at 12% 0%, rgb(77 104 228 / 0.7), transparent 60%), radial-gradient(60% 80% at 100% 20%, rgb(253 6 90 / 0.55), transparent 62%), radial-gradient(70% 90% at 55% 110%, rgb(163 63 189 / 0.7), transparent 60%), #14102E; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-title { margin: 0; max-width: 14ch; font: 600 3.5rem/0.98 'Bricolage Grotesque', 'DM Sans', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.045em; text-wrap: balance; } .ds-field-btn { padding: 0.9rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(110deg, #4D68E4, #A33FBD 48%, #FD065A); color: #fff; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.4s ease; } .ds-field-btn:hover { box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -10px rgb(163 63 189 / 0.75); } .ds-field-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-beam { position: absolute; inset: 0; border: 1.5px solid transparent; border-radius: inherit; pointer-events: none; -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(transparent, transparent), linear-gradient(#000, #000); -webkit-mask-clip: padding-box, border-box; -webkit-mask-composite: xor; mask: linear-gradient(transparent, transparent), linear-gradient(#000, #000); mask-clip: padding-box, border-box; mask-composite: intersect; } .ds-beam-dot { position: absolute; width: 220px; aspect-ratio: 1; background: linear-gradient(to left, #09C4F7, #A33FBD 45%, transparent); offset-path: rect(0 auto auto 0 round 40px); animation: ds-beam 9s linear infinite; } @keyframes ds-beam { to { offset-distance: 100%; } }

narrative.overview:
The whole system is the Sekeco logo's gradient (blue, purple, red-pink, with cyan as a spark) treated as light on a quiet ground. The ground is deep ink by default and lavender paper in light mode; the colour lives in the brand gradient, in cover cards, in the hero's blurred ambient light and in one closing field. Everything else is neutral and typographic: tightly tracked Bricolage Grotesque headings over DM Sans text, outlined cards, generous space.

The feel is techy and eclectic rather than corporate. The page is a calm dark surface that wakes up under the pointer: cards catch a soft neutral spotlight that follows the cursor, project cards tilt and glint, buttons lean toward the pointer and slide their gradient, and the hero breathes with blurred brand light. Structure is stable: a floating pill header, a side rail, a mosaic of projects, outlined capability and process cards, a marquee. Motion is GSAP reveal and scroll work with a reduced-motion fallback; hidden pre-reveal states exist only when JavaScript is running.
keyCharacteristics: Dark default, light mode swaps grounds only; the brand colours stay put.
Gradient is a fill and a light source, never a text colour (one logo-derived exception).
Headings 600 weight, -0.035em to -0.045em tracking; text DM Sans at 1.6 line height.
Large radii (20px cards, 40px closing field, full pills) and 1px hairlines.
Photographs on Works and Portfolio cards sit under a dark scrim; Solar Line Duotone is the only icon set.

rules.name: The Light, Not Paint Rule
rules.body: The brand gradient fills buttons, pill links, cover cards, the closing field and ambient hero light. Body copy, headings and icons never take it. The single exception is the footer wordmark, set in brand-soft like the logo itself; it is not a pattern for other type.

rules.name: The Tone Scope Rule
rules.body: A section fixes its own ground through a tone class (ink, paper, accent field, surface) that remaps text, muted, line and surface together. Never hand-colour text inside a section; read the scope variables.

rules.name: The Text Accent Rule
rules.body: Brand blue is a fill. Where blue must read as text or a focus ring, use the mode's accent (#3F59D6 on paper, #8FA2FF on ink).

rules.name: The Tight Display Rule
rules.body: Every Bricolage heading carries negative tracking from -0.035em down to -0.045em; larger means tighter. Body and labels are never tracked negatively.

rules.name: The Neutral Spotlight Rule
rules.body: Card light is neutral, never brand-coloured. The runtime smooths the pointer into --sl-x, --sl-y, fades presence --sl-p within 80px of the card, and raises --sl-flare on press. Spotlight, glare, tilt and magnet are pointer-only: hidden or skipped on touch and under reduced motion, and nothing depends on them.

rules.name: The Blur Boundary Rule
rules.body: Never put transform, filter or backdrop-filter on an ancestor of the fixed menu overlay; blur lives on a pseudo-element.

dos: Do use the brand gradient (110deg, #4D68E4, #A33FBD, #FD065A) for fills and brand-soft (adds #09C4F7 at the start) for hover states.
Do read colours from tone-scope variables so a section works in both modes.
Do use Solar Line Duotone icons from the generated set only.
Do keep card light neutral (spotlight white on ink, ink on paper) and drive it through --sl-*.
Do keep hover-only effects meaningful without them, and keep reduced-motion collapsing animations to near zero.
Do run photographs under the ink scrim so overlaid white text keeps contrast.
donts: Don't set body text, headings or icons in the gradient; the footer wordmark is the lone logo-derived exception.
Don't add box-shadows or coloured rings to cards; the spotlight is the only card response.
Don't add hard offset shadows, glyph icons, dashicons or glyph arrows.
Don't use backdrop-filter, filter or transform on ancestors of the fixed menu overlay.
Don't track Bricolage headings looser than -0.035em, or use it for body text.
Don't introduce colours outside the logo palette and the paired neutrals.
